scope: Theorem 3.2 (Separated pin interaction and conditional laws) of the manuscript “The critical correlation exponent of the planar XY model” (preprints/The-critical-correlation-exponent-of-the-planar-XY-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e58587be77cd0256), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the centered high law, Dn(H, p) ≥ 0 converges to the Gaussian pin interaction for precision a−1 EU (v) + ∥Bv∥2 . For every fixed finite list of density or box smears X, the conditional Laplace transforms and conditional weak laws given hp have the Gaussian finite-observation approximations just defined. Moreover, 0 < rH,n ≤ 1, Eµn rH,n = e−Dn(H,p) , and rH,n has the corresponding Gaussian approximation, whose limit is strictly positive almost surely. The convergence assertions persist when data are sampled under a fixed finite linear exponential tilt, with Dn and rH,n retaining their centered definitions and the limiting law sampled under the corresponding Gaussian tilt. The displayed expectation identity concerns µn, not its tilts. Conditional transforms for a tilted baseline also converge, by taking ratios of the centered conditional transforms.
